source_request: [$photo-prompt-image-generator](/Users/chasoik/Projects/image-prompt/skills/photo-prompt-image-generator/SKILL.md) 절대영역의 매력을 강조하여 보여주는 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성해줘
interpreted_intent: Create a tasteful sensual-fashion photograph that makes the exposed upper-thigh interval between a short skirt and thigh-high stockings the unmistakable visual attraction, using an unambiguously adult model and refined editorial styling.
subject: an unmistakably adult woman in her late twenties wearing a tailored black blazer, a short pleated skirt, and opaque charcoal thigh-high stockings
setting: a quiet contemporary hotel corridor with warm wood, brushed brass, and a softly reflective stone floor
event: she takes one measured step toward the camera while lightly adjusting one blazer cuff, creating a poised fashion-walk moment
visual_priorities: the clearly visible band of bare upper thigh between the short skirt hem and the stocking tops
elegant leg lines and tactile contrast among skin, matte stockings, and structured tailoring
baseline_prompt_en: A tasteful sensual-fashion editorial photograph of an unmistakably adult woman in her late twenties, walking through a quiet contemporary hotel corridor with warm wood, brushed brass, and a softly reflective stone floor. She wears a tailored black blazer, a short pleated skirt, and opaque charcoal thigh-high stockings. She takes one measured step toward the camera while lightly adjusting one blazer cuff. The clearly visible band of bare upper thigh between the short skirt hem and the stocking tops is the central visual attraction, framed by elegant leg lines and the tactile contrast of luminous skin, matte knit, and structured tailoring. Use a poised three-quarter full-length composition, soft directional amber light, realistic skin texture, restrained confidence, and premium Japanese fashion-editorial polish.
